verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents bulk user exports ('migrate your user data into and out of Auth0 with ... bulk imports and exports') and log streaming to external analysis services, so a documented exit path exists. A community report says getting an export with password hashes required a support ticket, so a complete self-serve exit is not evidenced. missing for 10: evidence of open/standard export formats, self-serve export of password hashes, documented export of tenant configuration and other non-user data, independent hands-on corroboration of a full migration off Auth0
